request.deadline: 18 months from approval, with milestones at Month 6, Month 12, and Month 18
deliverables: 18-month programme across India, Cambodia, and Kenya

M1 Month 6: Foundation operational, 200,000 cumulative farmers registered on Mainnet, AE credentialing live, trust-layer architecture locked, auditor procurement concluded, legal contract transfer prepared

M2 Month 12: 350,000 farmers across India, Cambodia, and Kenya, three application paths operating against verified trust-layer records, first independent audit, first stablecoin-rail loans disbursed and tracked
M3 Month 18: 500,000 cumulative verified farmers, three application paths operating, finance activity on Cardano, AE network credentialed, Foundation revenue model active, final independent audit
Application path WP3: AE certification with Andamio
Application path WP4: traceability and compliance with Zengate Global
Application path WP5: finance and credit with Seedstars SIGMA
request.recipient: 5am.earth Foundation, with Intersect administering funds through Treasury Reserve Smart Contract / Project-Specific Smart Contract framework
request.what: 5am.earth Foundation requests treasury funding to build an open, Cardano-anchored trust layer for global agricultural supply chains using Veridian identity, a Cardano on-chain satellite oracle, and application integrations for certification, traceability, and finance.

claims.claim: Project Swaminathan is operating on Cardano Mainnet with 10,500 cumulative farmer and farm registrations as of 5 May 2026.
The proposal says the pilot phase from January to March 2026 validated 1,056 farms across three phases at a 100% blockchain success rate and handled a same-day critical patch with zero downtime.
The requested 10,000,000 ADA is structured as milestone-gated payments of 5,000,000 ADA on approval, 2,000,000 ADA on M1 acceptance, and 3,000,000 ADA on M2 acceptance.
The proposer states the 10,000,000 ADA ask is approximately 2.86% of the ratified 350,000,000 ADA Net Change Limit.
The funded-period KPIs are 500,000 registered farmers, 2 million on-chain transactions, and $2 million in lending disbursed via Cardano stablecoin rails by M3.
The proposal projects that by 2030 the programme could reach 3 million farmers, 112.5 million annual on-chain transactions, $900 million TVL, and 16–20 million ADA in annual protocol revenue.
The proposer claims the Foundation will be structurally self-sustaining by 2028 through commercial partnerships and institutional backing and will not return to the Treasury for operating costs.
The proposal identifies named partners and components, including Syngenta Foundation India, Andamio, Zengate Global, Seedstars SIGMA, AIQuant, Anastasia Labs, DigiFarm, Veridian, and NMKR.
The treasury administration model uses Intersect, Sundae Labs smart contract tooling, a TRSC/PSSC structure, and an Oversight Committee of five external entities to verify administrative actions.
The proposal says the trust layer work is integration and scaling rather than greenfield development because the Cardano components are already implemented and operational on Project Swaminathan.

summary: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ADA for an 18-month, milestone-gated scale-up of a Cardano-anchored agricultural trust layer from an existing Project Swaminathan Mainnet base to 500,000 farmers across India, Cambodia, and Kenya, with named certification, traceability, and finance application paths and large 2030 adoption and revenue projections.
